subject: Order Form DPA: SCCs + hosting fallback — redlines & next steps
messages:
From: Evelyn Thompson <evelyn.thompson@cardiocloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Legal <markus.legal@cardiocloud.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CardioCloud — initial DPA redlines + SCCs question

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — were ready to move forward but legal has a couple blockers on the DPA and SCCs that we need to resolve before signature. Im attaching our redlines (PDF) and a short SCCs compatibility matrix. High-level asks from CardioCloud legal: 

- Clarify processor/controller roles in the MSA/Order Form (they want explicit language tying order form services to controller/processor roles).
- A fallback hosting commitment: if EU-hosted capacity is constrained, we need an explicit routing/fallback clause and a max period before failover.
- Confirmation of log retention and access for audit requests (SOC-scope).

Can you confirm your ability to accept the attached redlines or propose compromise language? Also looping Markus on this thread — hell handle any detailed legal back-and-forth.

Thanks,
Evelyn Thompson
Head of Security & Compliance
CardioCloud

Attachments: CardioCloud_DPA_redlines_20261115.pdf, SCCs_compatibility_matrix_20261116.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Thompson <evelyn.thompson@cardiocloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CardioCloud — initial DPA redlines + SCCs question

Evelyn — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Quick responses below; Ben and Laura are copied for legal/ops input.

1) Roles: We can add clarifying language in the Order Form stating service-specific roles (e.g., "Hosted API = Processor for inference-only features; Customer may be Controller for Customer Data"). Well propose a short exhibit that maps each product line to processor/controller responsibilities.

2) Hosting fallback: We can commit to an EU-primary hosting policy with a documented fallback to an equivalent EU region within 72 hours of sustained capacity shortfall, subject to notice and reasonable mitigation steps. We understand CardioCloud wants a maximum failover window; is 72 hours acceptable as a starting point?

3) Logs & audit: We already retain request-level logs for 180 days by default; we can offer an extended retention option in the Order Form as an add-on or include a 365-day retention for audit purposes for enterprise customers.

Action items Ill take this week:
- Draft the processor/controller exhibit and proposed fallback clause.
- Run the DPA redlines by legal and create a parallel redline with our counter-proposals (Ill attach a change log).

Can you confirm whether CardioCloud requires SCCs Annex III (the EEA-to-EEA supplement) or standard SCCs? That will change the exhibit slightly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

Referenced attachments: redline-change-log.txt
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Thompson <evelyn.thompson@cardiocloud.com>, Markus Legal <markus.legal@cardiocloud.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CardioCloud — DPA redlines (internal review + proposals)

Kimberly / team — I reviewed CardioClouds PDF redline and drafted our counter-proposals. Key notes from legal & infra: 

- Roles exhibit: propose a two-column mapping (Service -> Role) appended to the Order Form. Sample language: "For the Redwood Hosted API (Inference), Redwood acts as Processor; Customer remains Controller for Customer Input and Output unless otherwise specified in the Order Form."

- Hosting fallback clause (proposed):
  * "Redwood will maintain EU-primary hosting. If capacity constraints prevent EU-primary hosting for more than 48 continuous hours, Redwood will: (a) notify Customer within 4 hours; (b) provision equivalent EU-region capacity; and (c) execute routing failover within 72 hours, with roll-back options once capacity stabilizes."
  * Rationale: reduces exposure while giving ops flexibility.

- SCCs: We recommend standard SCCs with the EEA supplement (Annex III) included for clarity when EU regions are involved. Attaching a short matrix showing where each clause applies (SCCs_compatibility_matrix_20261116.xlsx).

- Audit logs: Ops can deliver a 365-day retention baseline for compliance customers. Longer retention available via paid add-on.

I attached a "redline-change-log.txt" that summarizes our edits and points that will need contractual approval (e.g., service credits if failover exceeds 72h).

If legal at CardioCloud needs a tracked-redline version in Word/DocuSign-ready form, I can convert. Kimberly, if youre good with these points Ill prepare the redline package and proposed Order Form exhibit.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Contracts, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline-change-log.txt
From: Evelyn Thompson <evelyn.thompson@cardiocloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CardioCloud — Order Form DPA: SCCs + hosting fallback — redlines & next steps

Kimberly / Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear proposals. CardioCloud legal reviewed Bens proposed language and were generally aligned. A few confirmations before we ask our GC to sign: 

- Roles exhibit: confirmed — the two-column mapping is exactly what we need.
- Hosting fallback: 72-hour execution window is acceptable to CardioCloud if Redwood provides a written failover runbook and a one-time service credit if failover exceeds 72 hours. Please add a short "service credit" paragraph to the fallback clause (we can negotiate percentage offline).
- SCCs: CardioCloud wants the EEA supplement included; thanks for calling that out.
- Audit logs: 365-day retention baseline is sufficient.

Next steps:
1) Ben/Kimberly: please send the tracked-redline Order Form + DPA with the Exhibit and fallback language (including the placeholder service-credit clause) by EOD Monday so our GC can review and prepare DocuSign.
2) Evelyn: well be ready to countersign within 48 hours of receiving the tracked-redline if no new material redlines surface.

Weve attached our internal checklist but wont re-send the full redline until we see your tracked changes.

Thanks again — small list and looks straightforward to close.

Best,
Evelyn Thompson
Head of Security & Compliance
CardioCloud
